data.title: Binance Bitcoin funding turns negative, and one analyst sees a possible reversal
data.description: Traders on Binance are now paying to bet against Bitcoin. That rarely happens, and the last time it did was in June 2026.CryptoQuant analyst Darkfost flagged the shift. He says negative Bitcoin funding on the world's largest crypto exchange may signal an early market reversal.On or around October 1…
